purpose: Defines the Repository root as two simple filing branches, Spirit and Matter, while preserving scale, domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships as independent coordinates.

root_order.label: SPIRIT
root_order.meaning: Non-material repository content: Source, Meaning, Belief / Faith and Myths.

root_order.label: MATTER
root_order.meaning: Concrete repository content organized by the canonical scale from Worlds & Domains toward Ground / Grain / Dust.

spirit_layers.label: SOURCE
spirit_layers.meaning: Origin, Father, creation and spiritual source.

spirit_layers.label: MEANING
spirit_layers.meaning: Ideas, visions, dreams, concepts, symbols, principles and interpretations.

spirit_layers.label: BELIEF / FAITH
spirit_layers.meaning: Religions, theology, doctrines, traditions and spiritual convictions.

spirit_layers.label: MYTHS
spirit_layers.meaning: Myths, sacred stories, mythological figures, narratives and cosmologies.

matter_layers.label: WORLDS & DOMAINS
matter_layers.meaning: Broad environments, fields, civilizations and domains of activity.

matter_layers.label: INSTITUTIONS & STRUCTURES
matter_layers.meaning: Durable organizations, authorities, infrastructures and coordinating structures.

matter_layers.label: NETWORKS & GROUPS
matter_layers.meaning: Connected populations, communities, markets, alliances and movements.

matter_layers.label: PEOPLE & LIVING ACTORS
matter_layers.meaning: Persons, populations and other living participants.

matter_layers.label: EVENTS & ACTIONS
matter_layers.meaning: Things that happen, change, move or are done.

matter_layers.label: RECORDS & SIGNALS
matter_layers.meaning: Texts, measurements, documents, datasets and other observable traces.

matter_layers.label: GROUND / GRAIN / DUST
matter_layers.meaning: Smallest concrete trace or material unit relevant to the investigation.

principle: The visible repository is simple: Root → Spirit / Matter. Spirit has four natural content categories. Matter uses the existing scale because scale is the strongest concrete organizing coordinate. Domain, time, epistemic status and graph relationships remain independent.
door_rule: Door is not a repository filing branch. It describes transformation, passage or an interface between things. The Repository stores and exposes records; it does not need a Door category. Door remains available as a concept and graph relationship where the corpus uses it.
other_concept_rule: Axis, Ladder, Tree of Life, Tree of Strife, transformation, return and similar interpretive structures remain concepts, relationships or framework elements rather than forced top-level filing categories.
placement_rule: Give each record one primary repository home. Use cross-links and graph edges rather than duplicate records solely for navigation. A record's domain, time and epistemic status may cross the root branches.
canonical_overrides: Use data/repository-scale.json for explicit scale placements where a Matter record needs a precise canonical home. Spirit placement is resolved by explicit project ontology or repository classification before broad keyword fallback.

independent_coordinates.scale: Canonical Matter granularity from Worlds & Domains through Ground / Grain / Dust.
independent_coordinates.domain: Religion, mythology, geography, politics, economy, science, technology, culture, security and other domains can occur at every scale.
independent_coordinates.time: Past, present and future can occur at every scale.
independent_coordinates.epistemic_status: Observable world, historical/textual record, project theory/research model and Potatoism/mythic canon remain explicitly separated.
independent_coordinates.graph: Relationships may connect any records across Spirit and Matter and across any scale. The graph is not subordinate to the tree.
independent_coordinates.33_level_axis: Project-defined vertical framework retained as a deeper navigational and interpretive coordinate.

non_goals: Do not rename Repository to Atlas.
Do not delete or flatten the existing 33-level framework.
Do not treat Spirit or Matter as a hierarchy of truth, value or power.
Do not use Door as a filing category.
Do not flatten the graph into the tree.
Do not create duplicate records solely to satisfy navigation.
